example.title: Front Street block with a long cream facade, Traverse City
example.place: Traverse City, Grand Traverse County, MI

brief: A long three-storey cream-painted commercial block with rows of arched windows, a bracketed cornice and shopfronts under flags. One photo. Older than 1970: Petoskey's Gaslight District (the town's model) is a row of 1880-1910 brick commercial blocks; no newer example of this main-street type exists. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
